title: ⭕️ IRGC explained:
text:
⭕️ IRGC explained:"

"💠 American Saildrone Destroyed in the Strait of Hormuz by IRGC Navy"

"🔹 The IRGC Navy (Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy) has targeted a U.S. unmanned surface vessel (USV), a Saildrone Explorer, in the Strait of Hormuz area."

"🔹 You should know that the Saildrone Explorer is a roughly 7-meter, long-endurance USV. It is equipped with cameras, communication systems, and various sensors for reconnaissance, surveillance, and maritime domain awareness (MDA) missions. It had previously been deployed in the region by the U.S. Navy’s Fifth Fleet and Task Force 59 — a unit whose operations center was in Bahrain and which was tasked with developing the U.S. Navy’s network of unmanned vessels and artificial intelligence."

"🔹 The U.S. naval base in Bahrain was targeted by Iranian attacks during the war and was put out of service! The Saildrone is now being used by a unit based in the Khasab area/sector of Oman."
